material: 6 mm AISI D2 tool steel (JIS SKD11 equivalent)
process: rough waterjet, vacuum harden/double temper 58-60 HRC, finish profile/faces grind

datum_scheme: A=shaft bore axis; B=ground stack face; C=keyway centre plane; verify datum marking on supplier inspection report
inspection: CMM/caliper against STEP and drawing; deburr and visual crack/warp inspection; inspect flatness/parallelism and stack gap with metal shims; hardness and post-treatment grinding report required
